tagline: Creating Value and Improving Lives Through Sustainable and Responsible Mining
hero_kpi_rationale: Substantial net income of $7,085M in 2025, representing a 135% year-over-year increase, reflecting the recovery in gold prices and the positive impact of portfolio divestitures following the Newcrest acquisition
company_description: Newmont Corporation operates as a gold producer. It also explores for copper, silver, lead, zinc, and other metals. It has operations and/or assets in the United States, Papua New Guinea, Australia, Ghana, Suriname, Argentina, Dominican Republic, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Mexico, and Canada. The company was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.

risks.title: Commodity Price Volatility
risks.summary: Fluctuations in gold and other metal prices directly affect revenue, profitability, and the value of mining assets.
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, strong language regarding direct impact on revenue and profitability. Presented as a recurring risk with high intensity, critical for the mining sector. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Newcrest Integration
risks.summary: The Newcrest acquisition carries significant integration risks, cost overruns, and operational disruption.
risks.score_rationale: Identified as a major risk in the 10-K, with explicit mention of high costs and operational risks. Alarming language regarding delays, cost overruns, and corporate culture. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Stringent Environmental Regulations
risks.summary: Increased rehabilitation and environmental compliance requirements raise future operating costs.
risks.score_rationale: Prominent position in the document, with mention of rising rehabilitation costs. Serious language regarding future obligations and potential fines. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks in Operating Regions
risks.summary: Operations in unstable countries expose the company to political, regulatory, and expropriation risks.
risks.score_rationale: Referenced in multiple sections, with mention of high-risk countries such as the DRC and South America. Cautious language regarding expropriations and political instability. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Legal and Regulatory Proceedings
risks.summary: Lawsuits related to labor and regulatory compliance could result in significant costs.
risks.score_rationale: Recurring mention of ongoing litigation, particularly in Australia (Fair Work). Precise language regarding provisions and financial risks. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Regulatory Changes in Ghana
risks.summary: The expiration of the fiscal stability agreement in Ghana results in a significant increase in taxation and royalties, with a direct impact on the profitability of Ghanaian operations.
risks.score_rationale: New and material risk following the expiration of the revised investment agreement on December 31, 2025. Income tax increase from 32.5% to 35%, new 3% gross revenue tax, and proposed variable royalties of 5% to 12% linked to gold prices. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Disagreement Within the Nevada Gold Mines Joint Venture
risks.summary: Disagreements with Barrick regarding NGM management could have a material impact on joint venture performance and Newmont's investments.
risks.score_rationale: Emerging risk flagged in January-February 2026. Newmont has identified evidence of mismanagement and resource diversion by operator Barrick toward its own properties, triggering the exercise of contractual audit rights. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Debt and Refinancing
risks.summary: Debt management and refinancing conditions could affect financial flexibility.
risks.score_rationale: Presented in financial risks, with mention of refinancing and interest costs. Less central than others, but closely monitored. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Key Skills Shortages
risks.summary: Shortage of technical and management talent in operating areas may adversely affect operations.
risks.score_rationale: Discrete but recurring mention of difficulty attracting and retaining qualified personnel. Measured language, but structural risk. (default score, subject to refinement)

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence was found in the 10-K document.
